notes.title: Green Hell VR - July 2022 Summary!
notes.content:
Hello Adventurers!
Before we get into the details, we would like to thank EACH and EVERY one of you for your continuous support of Green Hell VR. It is so humbling to see the positive reception of the game and how the fans are excited for what's to come in the Amazonian jungle. That being said, we won't stop now and continue working on the game more to bring you even more content and QoL changes - so stay tuned for future patches. Now, let's go on to the summary! In July, there has been a lot going on for us:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41356340/884d9fb814b422b59cdc93f61f384e464d9108db.png

1. Steam VR Fest
A lot of new people joined our amazing community because of the event, so we would like to, again, warmly welcome you! We also would like to thank Steam for organizing such an amazing event full of great-quality VR games - we were honored to be a part of this year's edition and hope to see more of such! Also, A Wolf In VR has helped us to bring more life to our Store page, so we are forever grateful :) Check out his stream on our page if you haven't yet. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41356340/6a5f79be2a99be26339d22479b722bbee19772e7.jpg

2. Steam Trading Cards
Our 2D Graphic Designer has put all of her heart into the creation of these Steam Trading Cards and we are more than proud of her :) What are you waiting for? Collect and craft your badge and wear it with pride! The artwork is simply breathtaking and, if you haven't yet, take a look at some of the cards below - you won't be disappointed:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41356340/235035115ba4ff3e1b86254b437db76dedd5e7c3.png

3. Challenge Mode Update (changelog)
One of the most anticipated (of course, after co-op - we are working on it!) updates to the game and it has been a blast. Despite some minor bugs here and there, everyone is thoroughly enjoying the challenges this update brought, and we are motivated by such a reception of the first major update of Green Hell VR on Steam. There will be more to come! Don't forget to join in on discussions in our community on Steam, we appreciate every form of criticism and feedback - we want to learn and grow along with our fans! Because of your input, we managed to even release a hotfix, so more people can enjoy it to the fullest now :) 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41356340/f2d082ac64ef0a91c853355c822ce8183c984b40.jpg

4. Metacritic
We are officially scored as a whooping 85! on Metacritic! Check the link below to drop a user review for the game as well - we appreciate the support!~
https://www.metacritic.com/game/pc/green-hell-vr

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41356340/69f5d449fc736f4e359340bd86b9983b58bdef65.png

Overall, we are very happy with how this month turned out to be and we are looking to the future and more exciting things for Incuvo as a company and Green Hell VR as a game. Stay tuned and see you back in Hell, Green Hell VR! 

Buy now! 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1782330/Green_Hell_VR/

notes.title: CHALLENGE MODE UPDATE OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Hello Adventurers!
Thanks a lot for all your support throughout this release - we are so humbled by the reception of our game and we continue to gather feedback from our players. This time, as a thank you, we are releasing a brand new UPDATE to the game adding a lot more fun things to experience in Green Hell VR. Check out the full changelog below:


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41356340/51b9face76dda3ae7b915a68bec0ee76c470ba2d.png

 Challenge mode added - interested in a different experience than your run-of-the-mill survival experience, then try the challenges with time limitations as well as special requirements to complete. We have plenty to choose from:
- The Campfire  (find the special Campfire and light it up)
- The Raft (find and build the raft)
- The Mighty Camp (build a camp using certain buildings)
 - The Hunter (collect meat from 13 different animals)
 - The Fisherman (catch 9 different species of water animals)
 - The Radio (find and collect a working walkie-talkie)
 - The Blacksmith ( craft a metal spear and metal armor - one for each limb)
For more information, open the game and choose the Challenge Mode in the Main Menu. Good luck!

 Steam Achievements! Want to go Vegan? or maybe become an Iron Man? Then now is the perfect opportunity to try something new and change your playstyle around in Green Hell VR :) You will find some familiar but also new achievements, so check out the Steam page for more information

 Left-hand mode added, so you can now choose which hand is controlling the movement and which rotation (Note: if you have set up custom input bindings via Steam, they will no longer work)


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41356340/32e31dcf1d732cbb926233a068f33fc8c6733c03.png

 Refurbished backpack system:
 - The hand has a proper pose when aiming at the backpack
 - Laser from hand is always visible when using the backpack
 - Just aim the held object at any point on the backpack and release it to add the item to the correct place, as if you were putting it by the shoulder. You can still choose the exact place to store the item when aiming at empty cells.
 - When you expand your backpack there is a new button to automatically sort items (instead of non interactable tabs)
 - Sticks and Bamboo sticks now have separate storage limits in the backpack, ten of each instead of ten in total and also the positions of sticks have been improved.
 - 10% bigger backpack
 - You can change the backpack tab from distance as well as directly with your index finger
 - The grid is always visible in the backpack
 - Fixed backpack issue when holding during loading

 Added 12hour clock display option
 The movement and rotation jitter has been eliminated thus improving the perceived smoothness of Green Hell VR
 Smooth rotation speed has been adjusted. 
 Added and tweaked some sounds (f.e. Rain, fire, animals)
 Added liquid amount display while holding liquid container
 The spawn position of ores has been adjusted
 Added auto-restart after changing performance mode
 Fixed swimming logic
 Stability of hands during snap rotation, jumping, crouching, and movements has been fixed.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41356340/bfe6302cbd1243fdf51e083e5c084851d9f8cc82.png

 Fixed item descriptions spinning in some situations
 Fixed an issue where the player could not fill bidon using mud filter
 Fixed an issue with a floating consume icon when the player dies
 A lot of grab points and colliders fixes (f.e. ladders, bowls)
 Additional LOD and visual fixes
 Players can no longer put fireplaces in crates and boxes.
 Fixed some bugs connected with teleporting
 Players will no longer be able to transfer the tutorial mask into a different save
 Fixed an issue when a player could strip his diving mask underwater
 Fixed bugs with arming and spawning traps. 
 Fixed an issue where player could farm skills on a dead body hanging on a snare trap
 Now player can't place a second bandage on an already bandaged wound
 Fixed soups color issue
 Now players can normally draw water from the ayahuasca cauldron
 Fixed weapon holding pitch settings not being applied correctly at game start
 Now the player cannot stand up when pressing sprint while crouching
 Fixed an issue where an arrow could not be stabbed into a tree
 Fixed noninteractable lianes in player proximity after loading the game
 Players cannot jump over the gate in the second dream sequence
 Water Lilies cannot fall underwater after they spawn
 The fire plow should no longer randomly disappear. 
 Fixed the issue with the interaction between the player's hand and the backpack.
 Fixed climbing gear teleport issues
 Players will no longer be able to stretch shower plug ropes.
 Players will no longer be catapulted while sliding from the slopes
 Better sound behavior when a hard object hits a soft object
 It is now easier to pick up fish from a stick fish trap
 Fixed bug where the player could stand and be underwater and still not be recognized as submerged
 Fixed some constructions that could be placed in water

notes.title: Patch V.1.0.7 Notes
notes.content:
Hello Adventurers!
Thanks a lot for all your support throughout this week - we are so humbled by the reception of our game and 200 reviews already. We have been working to deliver a patch as soon as possible to address many of the community's issues - so here is the changelog :)

FEATURES

 Added native Oculus VR launch option - so you don't have to use only SteamVR anymore!
 Refurbishment of the fire spreading system to make it more intuitive and immersive - now you can spread fire like the real survivalists! Throw a burning bird nest to light the campfire to then light a torch by the campfire, and many many more :) 

ADJUSTMENTS

 Tutorial Flow has been adjusted to better explain the fire tool
 Adjustment of the display of diacritic symbols
 Hand positions on many items have been adjusted (for example, palm/banana leaf)
 Badly formatted text in the third article in the third dream sequence has been adjusted
 Swimming on the water surface has been adjusted.
 The hand placement has been adjusted while holding mud
 Torch/Tinder is now extinguished if it touches the water

FIXES

 Players can no longer fly if they put items under their feet or if they pick them up (especially concerning the Fire Plow)
 Players can now again change settings after returning to the main menu
 After turning off the pause menu, you will no longer be able to witness exploding ragdoll physics
 Players can no longer take items from dreams
 Players can now normally fill a bowl with a brew from a different bowl
 The character won't be able to talk on the walkie-talkie while vomiting.
 The generator handle by the elevator no longer immediately falls out of your hands to be pulled endlessly.
 Now the fuel in generators will save normally, so it will be full after loading the saved game
 Players are no longer able to climb almost vertical walls
 Skipping tutorial during the campfire tutorial no longer leaves a notepad tab highlighted
 Players shouldn't have a problem with placing their Crafting Tables anymore
 Entering and exiting pause while sleeping will no longer reveal the player's body
 During the walkie-talkie dialogue, the backpack can now be normally grabbed
 Players can no longer hook up to the lift system while sleeping
 In the tutorial, players can no longer interact with the doors in the tent during dialogue
 Players can no longer dive infinitely without diving equipment
 When players release the Grab button when the Grappling hook is mid-air, they will now be able to pick it up again
 The collider size of a crafted item has been adjusted according to the item's ghost
 The walkie-talkie dialogue options won't disappear while holding the notepad
 Items will no longer get stuck in the Storage Box while picking them up
 Animals killed by snare traps are not floating in the air anymore
 Players can now fill bidon with water from a mud filter
 Some items will no longer behave weirdly when picked up from underneath other objects
 The kindling glow will no longer be so intense
 Resting places should have normal collisions now
 All trees will now correctly make a sound after being hit

... and many many more smaller bugfixes and changes! :) Stay tuned for more!

notes.title: Green Hell VR in a nutshell - it is NOT a simple port of flat Green Hell.
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 
We are so glad to have so many new people discovering Green Hell VR and supporting us. This will be our first piece of news on the Steam page and we are writing it to give you more information on what Green Hell VR really is. 

First and foremost, Green Hell VR is NOT a simple port of Green Hell or mod for Green Hell to include VR. It is a separate game. Even though it may seem like Green Hell VR looks and plays the same as the flat version, the game has many changes made to provide better integration with the VR systems. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41356340/71223aa0861f5376092aa06f41da3560fcb4b47b.gif

Green Hell VR distinct features are, for example :

Interactive world:
- the world is much more interactive as you can pick up and inspect nearly every object in the game
- collecting food and resources by collecting them with your hands manually or by cutting them down
- more immersive storytelling with interactive elements with integrated VR functionality like walkie-talkie and audio logs  
- making use of the VR controllers to physically swing your knife and cut down trees to collect wood

Items: 
- items in hand have proper physics and collisions with the world, allowing for new interactions and harvesting options
- managing items is now easier as you can use both hands to pick up items and physically use the backpack to store items
- intuitive crafting system (physically put the ingredients on the crafting bench to create a new item)

Player body:
- full body physics, with immersive limbs inspection, manual dressing wounds and picking leeches
- immersive swimming with the use of full-body moves
-  manually climbing ropes with your hands

Fighting:
- immersive bow mechanics
- intuitive battle system with multiple weapons
- VR functionality as throwing rocks, machetes, etc.

We cannot give any details yet. However, we can assure you that you won't be buying another version, but a different game whatsoever. In a matter of weeks, we will be uploading a new video comparison of the flat and VR version so players can see what to expect from this game. 

See you in Hell, Green Hell VR!
